Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for >100,000 CFU/mL Klebsiella pneumoniae, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Hematuria and mild proteinuria are present. Marked glucosuria with normal ketones may suggest hyperglycemia/possible diabetes. Low specific gravity may indicate impaired urine concentration. Clinical correlation and further evaluation for diabetes and urinary tract involvement are recommended.
